title: Ops Resilience: The Lights Go Out
description: Blackout. The attacker controls 12 substations and keeps moving.
storyContext: 3:14am — Jurong and Tuas go dark. Tampines and Bedok follow. The attacker holds 12 substations. The Minister wants answers in 30 minutes. Every second connected, they reach deeper into the grid.

callbacks.arc2-ch3:radio-reports: Those radio check-in drills from Northstar? Grid operators are running the exact same procedure by torchlight right now.

software-engineer.title: Stop the Spread
software-engineer.instruction: The attacker holds 12 substations and is moving to the next. Stop the spread.

options.label: Cut all connections to the 12 stations now. They go manual until cleaned.
options.consequence: Twelve stations go dark to the attacker — and to you. Manual crews roll out. The spread stops cold.

options.label: Set [[honeypot]] decoys on their next targets; watch them attack fakes. Risky if they don't bite.
options.consequence: They take the bait and attack a fake substation. You record every move. Sneaky. Brilliant. Terrifying.

options.label: Emergency-reset every password grid-wide. Locks out stolen logins — risky on live systems mid-crisis.
options.consequence: Every password resets at once. Somewhere, the attacker's session dies mid-keystroke. So does one unlucky technician's.

options.label: Flood the network with fake signals to blind the attacker. Buys time; blinds you a little too.
options.consequence: The network fills with ghost signals. The attacker slows, confused. So does your own team. Chaos cuts both ways.

data-scientist.title: Reconstruct How They Got In
data-scientist.instruction: Leadership needs the intrusion timeline — how they got in, what they touched.
data-scientist.hint: Evidence first, then chronology. Work back to patient zero.

items.label: Gather logs from every device and login system
Find the very first infected device
Trace how they hopped device to device
Extract their digital fingerprints to block re-entry

data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: The timeline snaps into focus: one fake email, three weeks of patient spreading. Now you can hunt.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: Conclusions before evidence — you chase a false trail while the real entry point sits in unread logs.

cloud-engineer.title: Isolate the Network Zones
cloud-engineer.instruction: Split the network so the attacker can't jump zones. Zone 1: cut off. Zones 2-3: restricted. Zone 4: normal.
cloud-engineer.hint: The scarier the zone, the tighter the lock.
cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Zones lock down in sequence. The attacker probes and hits walls everywhere. The grid holds.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: One zone too loose — the attacker slips through contractor access into a clean station. Tighten and retry.
